Database

Direct access to the active library database: read-only SQL for trusted clients such as lokictl, and the web client's boot handshake.

POST/api/db/queryAdmin#

Run one read-only SQL statement.

Built for lokictl and other trusted API clients. Two layers keep it read-only: - The statement must be a single SELECT or WITH (leading -- and /* */ comments and one trailing ; are allowed). Any other ; rejects the query, including one inside a string literal, so pass data through args. - It runs on a connection with PRAGMA query_only=ON, so SQLite refuses any write however it is phrased.

BLOB cells are returned as {"blob_bytes": n} instead of their contents. All errors, including 405, are application/json.

Request body

application/json

sqlstringrequired

One SELECT or WITH statement.

argsarray of any

Positional values for ? placeholders. JSON numbers bind as floating point.

limitinteger

Row cap. Zero or negative means the default; values above 10000 are clamped.

Default 1000. max 10000.

timeout_msinteger

Statement timeout in milliseconds. Zero or negative means the default; values above 30000 are clamped.

Default 5000. max 30000.

Example
{
"sql": "SELECT path, size FROM media WHERE path LIKE ? ORDER BY size DESC",
"args": [
"%/2024/%"
],
"limit": 100,
"timeout_ms": 5000
}

Response 200

Query result.

application/json

DBQueryResult

columnsarray of stringrequired
rowsarray of array of anyrequired

One array per row, cells in column order. A BLOB cell is {"blob_bytes": n}.

row_countintegerrequired

Rows returned.

truncatedbooleanrequired

More rows existed beyond limit.

elapsed_msintegerrequired

Query and read time in milliseconds.

Example
{
"columns": [
"path",
"size"
],
"rows": [
[
"D:\\Photos\\2024\\big.mov",
4831838208
],
[
"D:\\Photos\\2024\\a.jpg",
5242880
]
],
"row_count": 2,
"truncated": false,
"elapsed_ms": 3
}

Errors

  • 400Body is not valid JSON (bad json); the statement is not a single SELECT/WITH; or SQLite rejected or aborted the query (syntax error, write attempt, timeout), with SQLite's message. Error
  • 405Method other than POST. Error
  • 500No database connection available, read-only mode could not be set, or reading the result failed. Error
POST/api/db/loadRead#

Web client boot handshake (no-op).

The desktop viewer's "load database" call, mirrored for the web client. On the server it does nothing: the body is parsed and {} is returned, and the server keeps using its configured database. It is read access so anonymous boots work in public view-only mode. The method is not checked.

Request body

application/json

pathstring

Database path the client asked for. Ignored.

Example
{
"path": "D:\\Library\\dream.sqlite"
}

Response 200

Acknowledged.

application/json

EmptyObject

Errors

  • 400Body missing or not valid JSON. Error

Storage and Transfer

Browse and scan the configured storage roots (local folders and S3-compatible buckets), upload files into them, and move a curated library between servers with export and import archives.

POST/api/fs/listRead#

List a directory inside a storage root.

An empty path lists the configured storage roots themselves (each with type local or s3, and parent null). Otherwise lists the directory's entries through the backend that owns it. parent is null at a root. roots is always an empty array. The method is not checked.

Request body

application/json

pathstring

Directory to list; empty for the roots.

Example
{
"path": "D:\\Photos"
}

Response 200

Directory listing.

application/json

entriesarray of FSEntryrequired
parentstring | nullrequired

Parent directory, or null at a root.

rootsarray of stringrequired

Always empty.

Example
{
"entries": [
{
"name": "2024",
"path": "D:\\Photos\\2024",
"isDir": true,
"mtimeMs": 1704067200000,
"size": 0
},
{
"name": "a.jpg",
"path": "D:\\Photos\\a.jpg",
"isDir": false,
"mtimeMs": 1704067200000,
"size": 5242880
}
],
"parent": "D:\\",
"roots": []
}

Errors

  • 400Body is not valid JSON. Error
  • 403path is not within any configured storage root. Error
  • 500Listing failed. Error
POST/api/fs/scanRead#

List the media files in a directory.

Returns the media files under path (only direct children unless recursive). When path is a file, its parent directory is scanned and cursor is that file's index in library (otherwise 0). For S3 paths a trailing / marks a folder.

For admin callers, every scanned file is also added to the library (new media rows, and missing sizes backfilled). Anonymous public-access visitors get the listing without any write. The method is not checked.

Request body

application/json

pathstringrequired

Directory to scan, or a file to scan the directory of.

recursiveboolean

Include subdirectories. Default false.

Example
{
"path": "D:\\Photos\\a.jpg",
"recursive": false
}

Response 200

Media files.

application/json

libraryarray of objectrequired
pathstringrequired
mtimeMsnumberrequired

Modification time in milliseconds since the epoch.

sizeintegerrequired

Bytes.

cursorintegerrequired

Index of the requested file when path was a file, else 0.

Example
{
"library": [
{
"path": "D:\\Photos\\a.jpg",
"mtimeMs": 1704067200000,
"size": 5242880
},
{
"path": "D:\\Photos\\b.jpg",
"mtimeMs": 1704067300000,
"size": 4194304
}
],
"cursor": 0
}

Errors

  • 400Body is not valid JSON. Error
  • 403path is empty or not within any configured storage root. Error
  • 500Scan failed. Error
POST/api/uploadAdmin#

Upload files into a storage root.

Stores each files part under the destination directory, keeping its base name and adding _1, _2, ... before the extension when the name is taken. Parts that fail to open or store are skipped (logged); the request fails only when none succeed. Unless autoIngest is false, an ingest workflow is then queued for the destination directory. The request body is capped at 10 GB.

Platform difference: on Linux and macOS the destination field is ignored and files always go to uploads/ (a relative key) in the default storage root, and the ingest job's input is uploads/.

Request body

multipart/form-data

filesarray of string (binary)required

One or more file parts.

destinationstring

Directory inside a configured storage root (local path or s3:// prefix). Default: uploads/ under the default root. Windows only.

autoIngeststring

false to skip the ingest job. Any other value, or omitted, queues it.

Response 200

At least one file stored.

application/json

UploadResult

successbooleanrequired
filesarray | nullrequired

Stored paths; null on failure.

messagestring

Present on success.

errorstring

Present on failure.

Example
{
"success": true,
"files": [
"D:\\Library/uploads/a.jpg",
"D:\\Library/uploads/a_1.jpg"
],
"message": "Uploaded 2 file(s)"
}

Errors

  • 400The multipart form could not be parsed (including over 10 GB), destination is outside every storage root, or no files parts were sent. UploadResult
  • 405Method other than POST. text/plain
  • 500No storage root is configured, or no file could be stored. UploadResult
GET/api/exportAdmin#

Download a .lokiexport archive of the tagged library.

Streams a gzip-compressed tar, sent as an attachment named lowkey-export-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.lokiexport. It holds every media item that has at least one tag, plus the whole taxonomy and the embeddings, faces and people referencing those items: - manifest.json: format version, creation time, the source's storage roots and the item count. - library.db: a SQLite database with only the selected rows, each media path replaced by a flat, collision-free key (the file's base name, disambiguated with -1, -2, ...). - files/<key>: each item's bytes. Files that cannot be read are skipped, but their rows stay.

Thumbnails are not included; they regenerate after import. Errors after streaming has begun cannot change the status and leave a truncated archive.

Response 200

The archive.

application/gzip

string (binary)

Errors

  • 400No tagged media to export. text/plain
  • 405Method other than GET. text/plain
  • 500Selecting items or building the export database failed. text/plain
POST/api/importAdmin#

Merge a .lokiexport archive into this library.

Extracts the archive (rejecting members that escape the extraction folder), rebases every file key onto the destination root, copies the file bytes there, and merges by media item: an item already present is skipped whole; a new item brings its media row, tags, embeddings, faces and file. Taxonomy and tag groups merge without overwriting what exists. Face and person ids are remapped so curation references stay valid. The embedding and face search indexes are rebuilt afterwards; failures there become warnings. The request body is capped at 50 GB.

Request body

multipart/form-data

filestring (binary)required

The .lokiexport archive.

destRootstring

Storage root to import into, matched against each root's path or name. Omitted or unmatched: the default root.

Response 200

Imported.

application/json

ImportResult

importedintegerrequired

New media items merged in.

skippedintegerrequired

Items already present, skipped whole.

filesintegerrequired

File bytes copied into the destination root.

dest_rootstringrequired

Path of the destination storage root.

warningsarray of string

Non-fatal problems; omitted when empty.

Example
{
"imported": 1200,
"skipped": 34,
"files": 1198,
"dest_root": "s3://media/library"
}

Errors

  • 400The form could not be parsed (including over 50 GB), file is missing, no storage root is configured, or the archive is not a valid tar.gz or contains unsafe member paths. text/plain
  • 405Method other than POST. text/plain
  • 500The merge failed, including an archive newer than this server supports or one without library.db. text/plain

Transform and Models

Helpers for the Transform flow and the model pickers in the web UI: a dry-run preview of the prompt a retouch or reshoot job will run, the extra video models configured for reshoot, the active description prompt, the models of the local Ollama install, and the optional DirectML runtime used by the embed task.

All of these require an admin credential.

POST/api/transform/promptAdmin#

Preview the prompt a retouch or reshoot job will run.

Takes exactly the body POST /create takes and queues nothing. The job's arguments go through the same planning as the task, and the engine itself expands the prompt (--show-prompt, which loads no models), so presets, --append, living-photo expansion and reference tokens read exactly as they will run. When the engine is routed to a worker, the worker's engine answers.

input is parsed like /create: the first token is the task id (retouch or reshoot), the last token is the input (newline-separated file paths; quote it if it contains spaces), and the tokens between are options. Each non-empty fields entry is appended as --<key> <value>.

If the engine is not installed, a free-form prompt is returned as it will be sent (fromEngine: false, with a note); preset prompts cannot be expanded without the engine. A batch is shown for its first image (runs > 1).

Request body

application/json

inputstringrequired

<task> [options...] <input>, as for POST /create. Needs at least two tokens.

fieldsmap of string

Extra options appended as --<key> <value>; empty keys or values are skipped.

Example
{
"input": "retouch --preset=restore \"D:/photos/a.jpg\"",
"fields": {
"prompt": "Remove the scratches."
}
}

Response 200

The expanded prompt of the job's first run.

application/json

PromptPreview

enginestringrequired

One of "loki-retouch" "loki-reshoot".

promptstringrequired

The instruction as the engine expands it (empty when a preset needs the engine and it is not installed).

modelInputstring

Retouch only: the whole text-encoder turn, every reference announced by its token, then the prompt. Omitted when empty.

referencesarray of PromptReferencerequired
runsintegerrequired

Engine runs the job makes (one per image in a retouch batch; reshoot is always 1).

fromEnginebooleanrequired

False when the engine is not installed and the prompt was assembled by the server.

notestring

Explanation when the prompt is partial or shown for the first of several images. Omitted when empty.

Example
{
"engine": "loki-retouch",
"prompt": "Remove the scratches.",
"modelInput": "<|im_start|>system\nComprehend and analyze the provided prompt.<|im_end|>\n...",
"references": [
{
"token": "<image1>",
"path": "D:\\photos\\a.jpg",
"kind": "image"
}
],
"runs": 1,
"fromEngine": true
}

Errors

  • 400Body is not JSON (bad json) or input has fewer than two tokens (Invalid input). Plain text. text/plain
  • 405Method other than POST. Plain text. text/plain
  • 422The request cannot be previewed (unknown task, a query input instead of files, no input files, no prompt or preset, no image to edit, missing reference inputs). Error
  • 500The engine failed (for example --show-prompt exited with an error or a video frame could not be sampled). Error

GPU Engines

Where the loki-* GPU engines (loki-retouch, loki-reshoot, loki-dream, loki-segment) run. This is the engines section of the server config (EnginesConfig) plus the dispatcher's live state, and it backs the GPU Engines tab of the Config page.

  • Strategy local (the default) runs every engine on this machine's GPU; pool runs them on remote workers only; hybrid treats this machine's GPU as one more worker.
  • Pools are groups of interchangeable workers: kind nodes (loki-worker HTTP servers this server calls directly) or kind runpod (a RunPod queue-based serverless endpoint; files travel through a bucket or inline).
  • Routes override the strategy per engine, for example "loki-segment": "local". A route value is local, pool, pool:<name> or hybrid.
  • localOnly overrides the strategy and every route so all engines run here while the pools stay configured.

Worker tokens, RunPod API keys and transfer-bucket keys are never sent back: they read as <redacted>, and posting <redacted> back keeps the stored value.

GET/workersAdmin#

Old Workers page; redirects to the Config page's GPU Engines tab.

Response 302

Redirect to /config#engines.

GET/api/enginesAdmin#

Get the engines config (secrets redacted) and the dispatcher's live status.

The status is the last known state; nothing is probed. Use POST /api/engines/check to probe now.

Query parameters

localstring

1 adds local, this machine's engine installs. Reading an engine's version runs it once (--version, cached per file).

One of "1".

Response 200

Config and status.

application/json

configEnginesConfigrequired
statusEngineStatusrequired
localarray of LocalEngine

Only with ?local=1. One entry per engine in display order (loki-retouch, loki-reshoot, loki-dream in dream builds, loki-segment).

Example
{
"config": {
"strategy": "hybrid",
"pools": [
{
"name": "lab",
"kind": "nodes",
"nodes": [
{
"name": "gpu1",
"url": "http://10.0.0.5:8080",
"token": "<redacted>"
}
],
"maxJobs": 4
}
],
"routes": {
"loki-segment": "local"
},
"fallback": false,
"localOnly": false
},
"status": {
"strategy": "hybrid",
"routes": {
"loki-segment": "local"
},
"fallback": false,
"localOnly": false,
"placement": {
"loki-retouch": "hybrid",
"loki-reshoot": "hybrid",
"loki-dream": "hybrid",
"loki-segment": "local"
},
"targets": [
{
"key": "local",
"kind": "local",
"healthy": true,
"running": 0,
"slots": 1
},
{
"key": "lab/gpu1",
"pool": "lab",
"kind": "node",
"url": "http://10.0.0.5:8080",
"healthy": true,
"checked": "2026-10-31T12:00:00Z",
"running": 1,
"slots": 2
}
]
}
}
PUT/api/enginesAdmin#

Replace the engines section of the config and apply it.

Replaces the whole engines section, saves it to the config file and applies it at once (dispatcher targets and the GPU bucket size), then probes every worker (up to 20 s) and returns the new state.

  • A secret posted as <redacted> keeps the stored value: pools are matched by name (case-insensitive), nodes by url (ignoring a trailing /). A placeholder with nothing to restore is saved as empty.
  • A pool posted without provider keeps the stored one.
  • Routes present before and missing now are cleared (saved as "", meaning follow the strategy).
  • The section is normalized: unknown strategy becomes local; pools with a blank or duplicate name are dropped; any kind other than runpod becomes nodes; nodes without a url are dropped and an unnamed node is named after its URL; maxJobs <= 0 becomes 4; route keys are lowercased and prefixed loki- when needed.
  • Pools supplied by the environment (fromEnv) are never written to the config file.

Request body

application/json

EnginesConfig

strategystring

Asks the workers of one pool (every pool when pool is empty) to fetch and load the engines' models ahead of the first job. Worker nodes get a warm request; RunPod endpoints get a warm job (which also downloads the models to their volume). The local GPU is not warmed. Times out after one minute.

Scenes

The Scene editor's API. A scene is a layered composition over one still (an image, or a frame of a video). Each layer replaces a masked region of it: a still layer with a loki-retouch edit of a crop, a motion layer with a loki-reshoot animation of a crop, or a paint layer the user paints by hand (never generated). The engines take no masks, so every generation crops the layer's region from the flattened stills below it, runs the engine on the crop with nolibrary, and composites the result back through the layer's full-frame alpha mask PNG.

  • Each generation becomes a version of its layer; active picks the one shown. Motion generations are chained into a scene-lock job that freezes non-moving pixels to the still so region edges stay static.
  • Generations, roto tracking (scene-track) and exports (scene-render) are ordinary jobs on the queue. Finished jobs are folded into the document whenever the scene is read, so the editor polls GET /api/scenes/{id}.
  • The server owns the files under <data>/scenes/<id>/. Exports are the only files written beside the source (<name>_scene.mp4 or <name>_scene.png) and are added to the library.
  • Selection (/segment) keeps one loki-segment --serve session per scene, on this machine or on a worker node.

Scene errors are written by httpError: the body is the JSON Error shape but the Content-Type is text/plain; charset=utf-8. Unknown {action} segments answer a plain-text 404 page not found, and wrong methods a plain-text 405.

POST/api/scenes/{id}/segmentAdmin#

Find objects in the scene picture (or a motion version's frame) with loki-segment.

Answers one pick of the Select tool with SAM 3.1 masks the editor adds to a layer. Without layer and version it segments the picture as the editor shows it (every visible still and paint layer flattened over the base, cached until the layers change), in frame pixels. With layer + version it segments frame frame of that motion version's clip, in clip pixels.

Uses one loki-segment --serve session per scene (started on demand, closed when idle or when a GPU-heavy job needs the GPU). When loki-segment is routed to a pool, the session runs on a worker node; serverless endpoints cannot hold one.

Queue the layer's next generation.

Crops the layer's region from the stills below it (stitched, as the stage shows them) and queues the engine job, behind any generation of the layer already in flight (up to 8 running + queued). Dependencies

The server's external pieces in one list: bundled binaries shipped next to the executable (FFmpeg, FFprobe, ExifTool, the ONNX tagger and embedder, ONNX Runtime, FFplay on Windows), optional command-line tools the user installs themselves (yt-dlp, gallery-dl, Ollama, DiscordChatExporter), and on-demand models and tools the server downloads into its deps/models folder (SigLIP, the WD tagger, face models, faster-whisper, the loki-* engines and their weights, COLMAP, Brush, ...).

Access: these routes are registered without the auth middleware. The read routes (GET /api/deps/status, the progress stream) are always open, with CORS for the Electron renderer. The write routes (download, cancel, verify, delete) are also open by design, because the first-run wizard and the desktop app call them unauthenticated, except while Allow Public Access is on: then they need an admin credential (Bearer JWT, lk_ API key or the auth_token cookie) and answer 401 {"error":"unauthorized"} without one. This does not depend on whether first-run setup is complete.

Download state lives in memory: an install started here (or by a job that needs a model on first use) is tracked until the server restarts, and every state change is broadcast on GET /api/deps/models/progress.

GET/api/deps/statusPublic#

State of every bundled binary, optional tool and downloadable model.

Reads cached snapshots only and never starts an install or spawns a detection subprocess, so it is cheap to poll. Items come in this order: bundled, then optional, then manifest models and tools (Dream models are left out unless the server was built with the Dream feature).

For a model or tool with a tracked install in this server run, state is the install's state and detail is the install progress object. A model the user supplied themselves (a loki-* engine or third-party tool on PATH, weights next to such an engine, or a configured faster-whisper path) reports state: installed, source: user and detail: {"source":"path"}.

Response 200

Every dependency.

application/json

array of DepStatusItem

One dependency in GET /api/deps/status.

idstringrequired

Dependency id, e.g. ffmpeg, yt-dlp, siglip2-base-patch16-224, loki-retouch.

categorystringrequired

bundled ships with the server; optional is a user-installed PATH tool; model and tool are downloadable from the models manifest.

One of "bundled" "optional" "model" "tool".

namestringrequired

Display name.

featurestring

User-facing capability this unlocks (optional, model and tool items; omitted when empty).

descriptionstring

Longer explanation (optional, model and tool items; omitted when empty).

statestringrequired

Depends on category: - bundled: ready, missing or broken (the version command failed). - optional: installed or not_installed. - model / tool: installed or missing, or, while this server run tracks an install of it, the install state (queued, downloading, extracting, verifying, installed, failed, cancelled).

One of "ready" "missing" "broken" "installed" "not_installed" "queued" "downloading" "extracting" "verifying" "failed" "cancelled".

versionstring

First line of the tool's version output (bundled and optional items; omitted when unknown).

size_bytesinteger (int64)

Download size for this OS (model and tool items).

pathstring

Where it lives. Bundled and optional items when found; models when installed (the managed folder, or for a user copy the PATH binary or weights folder).

errorstring

Why a bundled item is missing or broken, or why a tracked install failed.

detailOptionalToolHint | ModelInstall | object

Extra data, varying by item: - optional: an OptionalToolHint (always present). - model / tool with a tracked install: the ModelInstall progress object. - model / tool supplied by the user: {"source": "path"}. Omitted otherwise.

sourcestring

user when the item is the user's own copy, used as-is and never downloaded, replaced or deleted by the server. Omitted for managed items.

One of "user".

Example

"category": "bundled",
"name": "FFmpeg",
"state": "ready",
"version": "ffmpeg version 8.0 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers",
"path": "C:\\Program Files\\Lowkey Media Server\\ffmpeg.exe"
},

GET/api/deps/models/progressPublic#

Server-Sent Events stream of model install progress.

On connect the server sends one event for every install tracked in this server run (any state, including finished ones), then one event per state change of any install. Each event is a bare data: line holding a ModelInstall JSON object (no event: or id: fields). A comment line : ping is sent every 15 seconds to keep the connection open. Events are dropped, not queued, for a client that falls more than 16 updates behind, so treat the stream as "latest state" and re-read GET /api/deps/status after reconnecting.

Response 200

The event stream; stays open until the client disconnects.

text/event-stream

string

data: <ModelInstall JSON> events separated by blank lines, plus : ping comments.

Example
data: {"id":"yunet","state":"downloading","current_file":"model.onnx","bytes_done":131072,"bytes_total":232589,"started_at":"2026-10-31T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-10-31T10:00:01Z"}

: ping

data: {"id":"yunet","state":"installed","current_file":"model.onnx","bytes_done":232589,"bytes_total":232589,"started_at":"2026-10-31T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-10-31T10:00:02Z"}

Errors

  • 500The response writer cannot stream. Plain-text streaming unsupported. text/plain

POST/api/deps/models/{id}/verifyPublic#

Check the files of an installed model or tool.

For a managed download, every file for this OS is SHA-256 checked against the manifest; a file that was extracted from an archive is only checked for presence (the checksum covers the discarded archive). For a copy the user supplied themselves (see GET /api/deps/status), only presence and, where the manifest knows it, size are checked, and source, location and note are set. The result is always 200; problems are reported per file. No request body.

Path parameters

One of "user".

locationstring

Where the user's copy lives. Only with source.

notestring

Explanation that only presence and size are checked for a user copy. Only with source.

filesmap of stringrequired

Map of relative file path (or, for a user-supplied tool, the binary's file name) to a result: ok, missing, ok (extracted from checksum-verified archive), ok (on PATH), a checksum error message, or a size-mismatch note.

Example

"id": "wd-eva02-large-tagger-v3",

DELETE/api/deps/models/{id}Public#

Delete a downloaded model or tool.

Removes the model's managed folder under deps/models and rebuilds the installed/missing cache. A missing folder is not an error. Copies the user supplied themselves are never touched (they do not live in the managed folder). An in-flight install is not cancelled first.

Settings and Session

Free-form key/value stores held in server memory for the web viewer. Neither store is written to disk: both are empty after a server restart, and the session store is also cleared when the server switches library databases. The current web viewer keeps its settings and session in browser localStorage and no longer calls these endpoints; they remain for compatibility.

Error bodies from these handlers are JSON ({"error":"bad request"}) but are sent with a text/plain content type.

GET/api/settingsRead#

The whole settings object.

Response 200

Settings (empty object after a restart).

application/json

object

PUT/api/settingsRead#

Set one setting or merge several.

If the body has a string key property it is a single update: settings[key] = value. Otherwise every property of the body is merged into the settings. A batch that happens to contain a string key property is therefore treated as a single update. Requires a credential even when Allow Public Access is on. Methods other than GET and PUT answer 200 with an empty body.

Request body

application/json

object | object

A body with a string key sets that one setting to value; any other object is merged key by key.

Example
{
"key": "theme",
"value": "dark"
}

Response 200

Saved. Body is {}.

object

Auto Scheduler

The auto scheduler keeps metadata generation caught up by running the combined per-item process job (with a --scheduled marker) whenever the machine is idle, and pausing it the moment the machine is needed: user requests to media, search and job routes, a queued job that shares its buckets, a fullscreen app, battery power, or CPU load above a threshold. Its mode (off or auto) is runtime-only and not persisted: every server start comes up off. Status changes are also broadcast on the /stream SSE channel as scheduler events.

GET/api/schedulerAdmin#

Current scheduler status.

The last status computed by the scheduler loop, which ticks every 15 seconds.

statestringrequired

One of "disabled" "waiting" "running" "yielding" "complete".

reasonstringrequired

Human-readable reason for the state, e.g. the app is in use, session locked.

jobIdstring

The scheduled job's id, when there is one. Omitted otherwise.

doneintegerrequired

Items processed by the scheduled job.

totalintegerrequired

Items the scheduled job will process.

opsstringrequired

Comma-separated per-item ops the job runs (default hash,dimensions,describe,transcribe,autotag,embed,faces).

signalsobjectrequired

The idle signals behind the decision.

cpuPercentnumberrequired

Total system CPU percent; -1 when unknown.

sessionLockedstringrequired

One of "yes" "no" "unknown".

fullscreenBusystringrequired

One of "yes" "no" "unknown".

onBatterystringrequired

One of "yes" "no" "unknown".

Seconds since the last keyboard/mouse input.

Onboarding

A single flag that tells the web UI whether the first-run tour has been dismissed. It is stored as onboarding.json in the server's data directory. Access follows the Dependencies routes: the read is always open, and the two writes are open unless Allow Public Access is on, when they need an admin credential (401 otherwise).

GET/api/onboarding/statePublic#

Whether the first-run tour has been dismissed.

A missing or unreadable onboarding.json reads as {"shown": false}.

application/json

OnboardingState

"dismissed_at": "2026-10-31T10:00:00Z"
}

Record that the tour was dismissed (now).

Saved. Empty body.

Setup Wizard

The first-run wizard at /setup and its JSON endpoints under /setup/api/. The wizard picks the database file, configures storage roots, offers model downloads (through the Dependencies endpoints) and finally marks setup complete.

Gating: while the config key setupComplete is false every route here is open (there is no account to sign in with yet), and the auth middleware redirects unauthenticated page requests to /setup instead of /login. Once setupComplete is true the endpoints stay mounted but require a valid credential (Bearer JWT, lk_ API key, or the auth_token cookie): the JSON endpoints answer 403 and the page redirects to /login.

setupComplete is set by POST /setup/api/complete. It is also set automatically at startup for installs that already have a real (non-default) account, and when the account is provisioned from the LOWKEY_ADMIN_USER / LOWKEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variables, so such installs never see the wizard.

Errors from these endpoints are written with http.Error: the body is JSON-shaped ({"error":"..."}) but the Content-Type is text/plain.

GET/setupPublic#

The first-run setup wizard page.

Server-rendered HTML. Open while setup is incomplete; afterwards it needs a valid credential and unauthenticated requests are redirected to /login.

Response 200

The wizard page.

text/html

string

Response 302

Setup is complete and the request carries no valid credential; redirects to /login.

Errors

Configured storage roots (empty array when none), with any S3 secretKey replaced by •••.

POST/setup/api/browsePublic#

List folders on the server host for the wizard's folder picker.

Unlike /api/fs/list, this browses the whole machine, because its job is picking locations before any storage root exists. Only directories are listed, hidden (dot) folders are skipped, and entries are sorted case-insensitively.

An empty path returns the starting locations: Home, App data, and every drive letter that exists (Windows) or / (elsewhere). A path that does not exist is not an error: it returns exists: false so the picker can offer to create it. A folder that exists but cannot be listed returns exists: true with no entries.

Request body

A JSON body is required (send {} for the starting locations).

application/json

pathstring

}

Response 200

application/json

SetupBrowseResult

pathstringrequired

The cleaned path listed (empty for the starting locations).

parentstring | nullrequired

Folder to go "up" to. Empty string at a drive or filesystem root (meaning the starting locations); null when listing the starting locations.

entriesarray of objectrequired

Subfolders (or starting locations), sorted by name.

namestringrequired
pathstringrequired

Absolute path.

existsbooleanrequired

The folder exists (always true for the starting locations).

writablebooleanrequired

A temp file could be created in the folder. False for the starting locations.

Example
{
"path": "D:\\",
"parent": "",
"entries": [
{
"name": "Media",
"path": "D:\\Media"
},
{
"name": "Photos",
"path": "D:\\Photos"
}
],
"exists": true,
"writable": true
}

Errors

POST/setup/api/storagePublic#

Replace the configured storage roots.

Validates every root, then saves the list as the config's roots and swaps the live storage registry (no restart needed). The submitted list replaces the existing one entirely.

  • type local (or empty, which becomes local) needs an absolute path; the folder is created if missing.
  • type s3 needs a bucket. A secretKey of ••• (the redaction placeholder from GET /setup/api/state) keeps the stored secret of the existing S3 root with the same bucket and endpoint.
  • An empty label defaults to the bucket name (S3) or the folder's base name (local).
  • When no root has default: true, the first root becomes the default.

Request body

application/json

rootsarray of SetupStorageRootrequired

"default": true
},

"endpoint": "http://localhost:9000",
"region": "us-east-1",
"bucket": "archive",
"accessKey": "minio",
"secretKey": "•••"
}
]
}

Response 200

Saved and applied.

application/json

statusstringrequired

One of "ok".

rootsintegerrequired

Number of roots saved.

Example
{
"status": "ok",
"roots": 2
}

Errors

  • 400Body is not valid JSON; no roots (add at least one storage location); a local root without an absolute path or whose folder could not be created; an S3 root without a bucket; an unknown type; or the storage registry rejected the roots (messages joined with ; ). Error

  • 500The config could not be saved. Error

GET/api/embeddings/projectionAdmin#

PCA projection of a model's embeddings to 3D.

Vectors are normalized and projected onto their first three principal components. Rows whose dimension differs from the first row's are dropped. When more rows remain than limit, a deterministic stride sample is taken so reloads show the same cloud. paths[i] is the item for points[i]. Any model with stored rows works, including ones no longer in the registry. A model with no rows returns empty arrays.

Query parameters

modelstring

Model id. Default the active embedding model.

limitinteger

Maximum points. Values above 20000 are clamped.

Default 4000. min 1, max 20000.

The projection.

application/json

modelstringrequired
dimintegerrequired

Vector dimension (0 when there are no rows).

totalintegerrequired

Rows considered before sampling.

countintegerrequired

Points returned.

variancearray of numberrequired

Fraction of total variance explained by each of the three axes.

pathsarray of stringrequired
pointsarray of array of numberrequired

[x, y, z] per point.

Example
{
"model": "siglip2-base-patch16-224",
"dim": 768,
"total": 51234,
"count": 2,

0.081,
0.054,
0.039
],
"paths": [
"D:\\Photos\\a.jpg",
"D:\\Photos\\b.jpg"
],
"points": [
[
0.12,
-0.03,
0.2
],
[
-0.08,
0.15,
0.01
]
]
}

Every metric is a row count, not bytes: media items, tag assignments, or one model's embedding or face rows, aggregated over each folder on the item's path (both / and \ separate segments). Legacy Media Browser

Endpoints behind the older server-rendered gallery at /media and the browser extensions. New integrations should use the Media Library endpoints instead.

Errors from these handlers are plain text (text/plain), not JSON.

GET/media/apiAdmin#

Paged items for the legacy gallery, or one item by path.

With path and single=true, returns the one item with that path (items is null when there is none).

Otherwise returns a page of items ordered by path. q uses the gallery's search language: key:value terms (keys from GET /media/suggest?kind=filters, such as tag, category, path, description, width, tagcount, exists, orientation), comparisons like width>1000 or tagcount:>2, * wildcards, AND, OR, NOT, parentheses, and implicit AND between terms. A query that fails to parse (for example a bare word with no key:) is ignored and every item is returned.

Query parameters

offsetinteger

Items to skip. Invalid values mean 0.

Default 0.

limitinteger

Page size. Values outside 1 to 100 use the default.

Default 25. min 1, max 100.

qstring

Search expression.

pathstring

Media path for a single-item lookup (read from the raw query string and path-unescaped). Ignored unless single=true.

singlestring

true together with path looks up one item.

One of "true".

Response 200

A page of items.

application/json

has_morebooleanrequired

Total matching items (for a single lookup, 0 or 1).

"category": "Scene"

],

"duplicateCount": 0

MediaQueryPredicateobject#

One filter or ranking term. value semantics by type: - tag: exact tag label; the item has that tag. - category: exact category label; the item has any tag in that category. - path, description, hash: substring match (LIKE '%value%', case-insensitive for ASCII; % and _ in the value are wildcards). - orientation: landscape, portrait or square (case-insensitive), comparing stored width and height. Items without dimensions never match an include and are kept by an exclude. Other values match nothing. - faces: only ungrouped: items with at least one detected face and no face assigned to a person. Other values match nothing. - dupe: a duplicate group id (active, non-excluded members of that group), pending (members of pending groups) or any/all (every grouped item, dismissed groups included). Other values match nothing. - similar (visual): a library media path; ranks by image-embedding similarity to it, embedding the file on the fly if it has no vector. - visual (visual): free text; text-to-image search. - clip (visual): an image as a base64 data URL (data:image/png;base64,...) or bare base64; image-to-image search. - face (visual): a library media path or an image data URL; face-identity search, one hit per media item. Ignores text and nodes.

For an exclude of a "matches nothing" value (unknown orientation, faces or dupe value, or a visual predicate with no hits), nothing is removed.

typestringrequired

One of "tag" "category" "path" "description" "hash" "orientation" "faces" "dupe" "similar" "visual" "clip" "face".

valuestringrequired

Operand; meaning depends on type. An empty value removes the predicate from the query.

excludeboolean

Negate the predicate (NOT EXISTS, NOT LIKE, NOT IN).

Default false.

joinstring

Connector to the running result of the predicates before it. Missing, empty or any other value falls back to mode. Ignored on the first predicate.

One of "AND" "OR" "".

textstring

Legacy blend, similar and clip only. Free text mixed into the image query as one combined vector. Without nodes it is a two-way image/text blend; with nodes it is folded in as one more text term weighted by textWeight.

textWeightnumber

Share of text in the blend, clamped to 0 to 1 (0 = pure image, 1 = pure text). Missing means 0.5.

Default 0.5. min 0, max 1.

nodesarray of MediaQueryBlendNode

Composite similarity for similar, clip and visual. The predicate's own value is the base term with weight 1; each node adds a signed weighted term. Nodes with weight 0 are skipped.

blendModestring

How a predicate with nodes is scored. blend (or empty, or any value other than shared) combines all terms into one centroid vector. shared scores candidates against every positive term at once (must match all), finding what the positive terms have in common.

One of "blend" "shared" "". Default "blend".

MediaQueryRequestobject#

Body of POST /api/media/query. There is no paging, limit or cursor; the full result is returned.

modestring

Connector for predicates without their own join. Anything other than exactly OR means AND.

One of "AND" "OR". Default "AND".

predicatesarray of MediaQueryPredicate

Evaluated left to right. Missing or empty returns the whole library.

TaskOptionobject#

typestringrequired

How the value is parsed: - bool: --name alone means true; --name=true|1|yes or a following true/false/1/0/yes/no token sets it explicitly. - number: parsed as a float; an unparsable value leaves the default. - string, enum, multi-enum: the following token (unless it starts with --) or the = value, as a string.

Allowed values for enum and multi-enum. Omitted when empty.

defaultany

Value used when the option is absent (string, boolean, number or array depending on the task). Omitted when the option has no default, in which case it defaults to false, 0 or an empty string by type.

requiredboolean

Marked as required in the UI. Omitted when false.

nodes pools: the workers.

The created job ids, in node order. null when the DAG was empty (POST /workflow only).

WorkflowTaskobject#

One DAG node; becomes one job.

idstringrequired

Node id, unique within the DAG and referenced by other nodes' dependencies. In saved workflows it is a template id replaced by a fresh UUID at run time; in POST /workflow it becomes the job id.

commandstringrequired

Task id (see GET /tasks).

argumentsarray | null

Option tokens, already split (for example ["--apply", "all"]).

inputstring

The node's own input. At claim time each dependency's output files are appended one per line.

dependenciesarray | null

Ids of nodes in the same DAG that must complete first.
